messages.text: How do I order a cup of tea?

blocks.markdown: You can say it like this:

blocks.romanization: wǒ xiǎng yào yì bēi chá
blocks.meaning: I would like a cup of tea.

blocks.romanization: qǐng gěi wǒ yì bēi rè chá
blocks.meaning: Please give me a cup of hot tea.
